scope.head: fdc2e2878b70227a325326c4acef892b3b7d2462
scope.reviewed_change: fdc2e28 and corrected diagnostic reports observed in the working tree

summary: The corrected implementation closes both prior blocking findings. Holdout execution and GPU_BLOCKED recording reject any custom output root before touching the holdout policy or artifacts, so the repository-controlled report tree remains the consumption boundary. The five corrected diagnostic variants now persist their exact runtime configuration, and each regenerated dev/validation report matches the code's execution configuration. Independent 200-case schema/hash/gold/split validation, focused and full tests, protected-file checks, and the no_selection/GPU_BLOCKED evidence all pass.

audit_trail.title: Holdout consumption could be bypassed through a custom output root
resolution_evidence: Commit fdc2e28 rejects split=holdout with a non-null output_root in both retrieval_benchmark.run and retrieval_benchmark.record_gpu_blocked, before _assert_holdout_policy or any output operation.
An independent direct probe of both APIs with an audit-custom-root raised PermissionError: 'Holdout reports must use the repository-controlled default output root'.
tests/test_retrieval_benchmark.py includes a regression test for run(..., split='holdout', output_root=Path('outside')).

audit_trail.title: Diagnostic reports lacked exact executed configurations
resolution_evidence: Commit fdc2e28 adds _executed_config(), recording mode, rerank state, candidate_k, k_metrics, seed, graph_mode, diagnostic status, and R6/R7/R8 effective parameters independently of the display variant.

The corrected dev and validation reports for R0-GRAPH-AUTO-DIAGNOSTIC, R0-GRAPH-ON-DIAGNOSTIC, R6-BM25-DIAGNOSTIC, R7-BM25-DIAGNOSTIC, and R8-BM25-DIAGNOSTIC were independently compared to _executed_config(); all ten configurations matched exactly and record commit fdc2e28.
The focused regression test confirms actual graph mode and R6 effective parameters.

checklist.area: 200-case schema, hash, gold, and split integrity
checklist.evidence: tools/build_retrieval_benchmark.py --check passed with 200 cases, 120/40/40 dev/validation/holdout counts, question_gold_separated=true, gold_ids_resolved=true, split_overlap=false, and manifest SHA-256 326a405748dd20f641d5cf4103ceaafb6a19f07b43db54d95f472a2b439e3071. A separate JSONL audit recomputed question/gold counts and ID equality for every split, verified zero cross-split overlap and 200 total IDs, and matched each question, gold, and schema SHA-256 to the manifest.

The manifest-bound declaration remains the authorization input, and both executable holdout paths now reject custom output roots. This removes the previously confirmed path that could write a consumed holdout report outside the repository-controlled scan.

Corrected R0 graph diagnostics record graph_mode auto/on; corrected R6/R7/R8 diagnostics record their BM25 base, graph_mode off, diagnostic status, and effective experiment parameters. All five corrected variants have matching dev and validation reports produced at fdc2e28 and equal to the runtime configuration helper.
.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m unittest tests.test_retrieval_benchmark passed 19 tests. .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m unittest discover -s tests -p test*.py passed 151 tests.

checklist.area: Official starter-pack and Member B boundaries
checklist.evidence: The complete branch diff from merge-base a179af7 changes no official starter-pack path, including data/sample_50.jsonl, schema/, Ejemplo de entrega/, or docs/OFFICIAL_SHA256.txt. It changes no Member B decoder, generation, evaluation, or reasoning configuration. tools/evaluate_retrieval_benchmark.py is a retrieval benchmark evaluator within Member A's owned retrieval surface, not Member B generation/evaluation code.

selected_config.json remains status=no_selection with only R0 eligible. Its five stated validation metrics exactly match the final R0 validation report. The CPU graph and metadata runs retain DIAGNOSTIC labels and are excluded from selection.

All reports for R1-BGE, R1-QWEN, R2-BGE, R2-QWEN, R3, R4, R5, R6, R7, and R8 marked GPU_BLOCKED have no metrics and state prerequisites. This audit environment has torch 2.12.0+cpu, cuda_available=false, cuda_device_count=0, no nvidia-smi, and no corpus/index/dense.npy; the blocked status is therefore supported locally without claiming status on another machine.

non_blocking_observations.title: Corrected diagnostics are untracked at audit time
non_blocking_observations.evidence: The corrected report directories and corrected statistics files are present as untracked working-tree artifacts. Their provenance and configurations were verified for this audit, but they must be committed with the intended change for a clean downstream handoff.

non_blocking_observations.title: CRLF patch-hygiene output
non_blocking_observations.evidence: git diff --check emits CRLF trailing-whitespace notices for pre-existing branch additions because .gitattributes uses * -text. This does not affect the benchmark safety verdict.
